# Awesome Garden Software

## Planning

- Seed catalogues
  - [Seedbank](https://github.com/example-owner/seedbank) - Keeps track of seeds.
  - [Sprout Calendar](https://sprout.example.com) - When to sow what.
- [Plot Planner](https://github.com/example-owner/plot-planner) - Draws beds on a grid.
  - [Plot Planner Web](https://plot.example.com) - The same, in a browser.
    - [Plot Themes](https://example.com/plot-themes) - Colours for the planner.
- Watering
  - Timers
    - [Drip Clock](https://example.net/drip-clock) - Opens a valve on a schedule.
- This bullet is a whole sentence of advice that goes on for far too long to be a section name
  - [Trowel Notes](https://trowel.example.com) :: Written with two colons.
